_comment: Single source of truth for the hub grid. Keep in sync with lib/portfolio-data.ts in kbrovibes/portfolio.

projects.title: Hanger Management
projects.blurb: AI personal stylist. Catalogues every piece you own, builds a photoreal mannequin of you, and shows you wearing the outfit before you get dressed.

projects.title: stonkbro
projects.blurb: Options-trading copilot for premium sellers. Live chains, a PMCC scanner, AI research, position tracking, and roll/close signals. Definitely not financial advice.

projects.title: MarketMath
projects.blurb: Fundamentals dashboard for the S&P 500. Twenty years of as-filed 10-K data, reverse DCF, transparent quality scores — every number traceable to an SEC filing.

projects.title: OpenCourt
projects.blurb: Club badminton tournaments that don't feel like spreadsheets. Share a link, tap players into teams, and run the whole bracket from a phone at courtside.

projects.title: snobaddy
projects.blurb: A digital whiteboard for a Monday/Thursday badminton club in Snoqualmie. Sessions, check-ins, match generation, season leaderboards. Wildly over-engineered.

projects.title: wisesplit
projects.blurb: Splitwise without the paywall. Debt-graph settle-up, natural-language quick add, multi-currency, offline PWA. Pure SVG, zero tracking, free forever.

projects.title: superhero-stories
projects.blurb: 482 original superhero stories across Marvel, DC and the Avengers, as a fully static web app. Written for a seven-year-old audience.

projects.title: bro-toolkit
projects.blurb: Portable Mac toolkit — Claude skills, zsh/tmux configs, and a kbro CLI. One command to set up a new machine, and one command to remove every trace.
